gloss: to hit the mark; to come true; to be right on target

definitions.gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target
definitions.explanation: For a projectile, arrow, or shot to hit its intended target.

definitions.gloss: to come true; to prove correct; to be right on target
definitions.explanation: For a prediction, forecast, or guess to turn out to be accurate.

examples.japanese: {矢|や}が{的|まと}に{的中|てきちゅう}した。
{弾丸|だんがん}が{命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{箇所|かしょ}に{的中|てきちゅう}した。
examples.english: The bullet hit a vital area.

examples.japanese: {三本|さんぼん}の{矢|や}がすべて{中心|ちゅうしん}に{的中|てきちゅう}して、{観客|かんきゃく}が{沸|わ}いた。
examples.english: All three arrows hit the center of the target, and the crowd erupted.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}が{的中|てきちゅう}した。
{彼|かれ}の{予想|よそう}はみごとに{的中|てきちゅう}した。
{宝|たから}くじの{番号|ばんごう}が{的中|てきちゅう}して、{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: My lottery numbers hit, and I won one million yen.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 (predictions coming true) is more common in everyday usage. The noun form {的中|てきちゅう} is also used, as in {的中率|てきちゅうりつ} (hit rate, accuracy rate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予想|よそう}が{的中|てきちゅう}する (a prediction comes true)
- {予報|よほう}が{的中|てきちゅう}する (a forecast proves correct)
- {的中率|てきちゅうりつ} (accuracy rate, hit rate)
- みごとに{的中|てきちゅう}する (to prove brilliantly correct)

RELATED WORDS:
- {命中|めいちゅう}する: to hit (a target)
- {当|あ}たる: to hit; to be correct
- {予言|よげん}が{当|あ}たる: a prophecy comes true
